Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.network

Interface Payload

All Known Implementing Classes:
EyeAngerPacket, EyeBehaviorTriggerPacket, EyeConfigSyncPacket, EyeSettingsPacket, EyeStatePacket, PickerExportPacket, PickerFreezePacket
public interface Payload
One of the mod's payloads: its id and its body. Each payload class pairs this with a static read(FriendlyByteBuf) that validates on decode; the loader bridges Networking and ClientNetworking send it on that id.

CLIENTBOUND and SERVERBOUND are the one declaration of every payload, its direction, and what handles it on arrival; each loader registers from them. Clientbound handlers reach ClientNetworkHandler only inside lambda bodies, so a dedicated server never links it.
